visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A brown and white tabby cat stands on its hind legs, vigorously scratching at a frosted glass panel set into a white interior door. The cat is viewed from behind, showing its striped back and twitching tail. A green leaf-patterned rug lies on the tiled floor in front of the door. (2) The perspective shifts to the other side of the door where a person's hand reaches out to tap the frosted glass from within. A dark silhouette of the cat is visible through the glass, mirroring the tapping motion of the person. The lighting is bright and indoor. (3) Returning to the hallway view, the cat jumps up and scratches the door again with its front paws. White text overlays appear at the top, explaining the cat's habit. The background remains the static white door and tiled floor under natural-looking artificial lighting. (4) The cat performs a high jump, paws reaching towards the upper portion of the glass pane while continuing the scratching motion. The camera angle is slightly lower to capture the cat's physical exertion and the intensity of the interaction through the door.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-frequency repetitive scratching sounds of cat claws on glass dominate the acoustic space from the start. The background features a light, upbeat acoustic BGM with a moderate tempo around 105 BPM. No vocal track is present, maintaining a focused environmental sound profile without verbal interruption. (2) A series of hollow tapping sounds occurs as a human hand interacts with the frosted glass from the opposite side. The BGM continues steadily in the mix, and the scratching texture persists intermittently, creating a layered dialogue between the two distinct mechanical sound sources. (3) A blunt thudding impact sound with low spectral bandwidth is heard as the cat jumps against the lower door panel. The BGM remains constant in volume and texture, providing a rhythmic base while the ambient room tone remains minimal and unobtrusive throughout this phase. (4) Continuous rapid scratching sounds resume with sharp transients as the cat repeats its pawing motion. The playful BGM continues its melodic loop until the video ends, with no other significant acoustic events or voice-overs detected, keeping the soundscape simple, direct, and focused on the interaction.
